airline.book_reservation: Creates a new reservation and charges the listed payment methods. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact booking details and amounts.
airline.cancel_reservation: Cancels the named reservation. It is a database write and is allowed only when the airline cancellation rules are satisfied.
airline.send_certificate: Sends or applies a travel certificate. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact certificate action.
airline.update_reservation_baggages: Changes the baggage count on an existing reservation. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact baggage change and payment details.

update_reservation_flights.description: Changes flight or cabin details on an existing reservation. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact route, cabin, passengers, dates, and price.

cabin.instruction: Use one of these exact JSON strings. Do not replace underscores with spaces.

airline.update_reservation_passengers: Changes the passengers on an existing reservation. It is a database write and is restricted by the passenger-count policy.

retail.cancel_pending_order: Cancels an entire pending order. It is a database write and cannot cancel only one item.
retail.exchange_delivered_order_items: Submits a one-time exchange for specified items in a delivered order. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the complete item list, replacement items, and payment method.
retail.modify_pending_order_address: Changes the shipping address on a pending order. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact address and order.
retail.modify_pending_order_items: Changes specified items on a pending order. It is a one-time database write that changes the order state so later modifications may no longer be allowed; all item changes must be collected first.
retail.modify_pending_order_payment: Changes the payment method on a pending order. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact order and payment method.
retail.modify_user_address: Changes the user's default address. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the exact address.
retail.return_delivered_order_items: Submits a one-time return for specified items in a delivered order. It is a database write and needs confirmation for the complete item list and refund method.
